description: Log a DEFECT from a FAILED step of an execution — what "Log Defect" in the execution report does — and link it to that step. Pass `executionId` (EX-170 or 170) and `step` (the step number in the report; it must have failed). If the execution ran several test cases, also pass `tc`. The defect is pre-filled from the report: test case + version, steps to replicate up to the failure, execution, environment, browser, expected vs actual and the error message, and the step's screenshots; its release / sprint / module come from the execution / test case. Optional: `name` (default "TC-41 step 7 failed: … (EX-170)"; a defect with that name already existing is refused — link it with defect_link_step instead), `description` (extra notes), `state` / `priority` / `severity` (the project's own values, default = the project's defaults), `assignee` (email, name, user id or "me"). Needs the add_defect privilege. Returns the defect key (DE-xx); the test case then lists it too. To attach a step to a defect that already exists, use defect_link_step.

assignee.description: Email, name, numeric user id or "me".

description.description: Extra notes added to the defect description.

executionId.description: Execution id or code: EX-170 or 170.

step.description: Step number as shown in the report; it must be a FAILED step.

tc.description: Test case id or code (TC-41) — only when the execution ran several test cases.

name: defect_create_from_step
title: Log a defect from a failed execution step
